rule.name: Reject suspicious 4K upscale
rule.when:
(kind == "movie" or kind == "series")
and resolution == "2160p"
and not library
and exists(
    resolution == "1080p"
    and "remux" in traits
)
and none(
    resolution == "2160p"
    and "remux" in traits
)
and none(
    resolution == "2160p"
    and (
        matched("Movies UHD BluRay T1 Groups")
        or matched("Movies UHD BluRay T2 Groups")
        or matched("Movies UHD BluRay T3 Groups")
        or matched("Movies WEB T1 Groups")
        or matched("Movies WEB T2 Groups")
        or matched("Movies WEB T3 Groups")
        or matched("Shows BluRay T1 Groups")
        or matched("Shows BluRay T2 Groups")
        or matched("Shows WEB T1 Groups")
        or matched("Shows WEB T2 Groups")
        or matched("Shows WEB T3 Groups")
    )
)

rule.name: Adaptive low-quality filtering
rule.when:
not library
and (
    "hdrip" in traits
    or "dvdrip" in traits
    or "hdtv" in traits
)
and count(
    (
        resolution == "2160p"
        or resolution == "1440p"
        or resolution == "1080p"
        or resolution == "720p"
    )
    and (
        "remux" in traits
        or "bluray" in traits
        or "webdl" in traits
    )
) > 6

rule.when: matched("Shows LQ Groups")

rule.when: matched("Movies Bad Dual Groups")

rule.when: not isAnime and matched("Shows Bad Dual Groups")

rule.name: Anime LQ Penalty
rule.when:
isAnime
and matched("Anime LQ Groups")
and not (seadex.best or seadex.alternative)

rule.name: Adaptive HD x265
rule.when:
not isAnime
and parsed.codec == "hevc"
and not ("remux" in traits)
and not any(hdr, # == "HDR" or # == "HDR10+" or # == "DV")
and not library
and (
  (
    resolution == "1080p"
    and count(
      resolution == "1080p"
      and parsed.codec == "avc"
      and (
        "remux" in traits
        or "bluray" in traits
        or "webdl" in traits
      )
    ) > 6
  )
  or
  (
    resolution == "720p"
    and count(
      resolution == "720p"
      and parsed.codec == "avc"
      and (
        "bluray" in traits
        or "webdl" in traits
      )
    ) > 6
  )
)

rule.name: 1080p Remux Preference
rule.when:
(kind == "movie" or kind == "series")
and not isAnime
and resolution == "1080p"
and "remux" in traits
and not library
and count(
  resolution == "2160p"
  and "webdl" in traits
  and not any(hdr, # == "HDR" or # == "HDR10+")
) > 0
and count(
  resolution == "2160p"
  and "webdl" in traits
  and any(hdr, # == "HDR" or # == "HDR10+")
) == 0
